brief.description: Compact brimstone-yellow sulfur chunk with broad crystal facets and restrained mineral fracture texture
brief.purpose: Distinct refinery coproduct and fertilizer ingredient, recognizable beside coal and metal ingots.
brief.silhouette: One squat irregular yellow mineral clump with three broad angular lobes, not tall quartz spikes or powder.
brief.bounds: 32x32 transparent item sprite, 28px extent, native item/generated extrusion.
brief.materials: Brimstone lemon-yellow sulfur, pale cream facet highlights, muted ochre shadow cracks; no metallic gold shine.
brief.interfaces: Existing sulfur registry and standard inventory/held/frame rendering.
brief.construction: Generated high-resolution master reduced through shared alpha-safe item pipeline.
brief.invariants: No recipe, balance, stack size or acquisition changes.
fidelity_targets: Three large yellow crystal faces separated by ochre creases
Sparse broad chips/fracture marks visible at native size
No blank plastic planes or microcrystal noise

references.role: Approved family style only: coarse purposeful clusters, material variation and upper-left light. Do not copy cloth subject, folds, stripe or palette.

generations.prompt: Create a new isolated Minecraft inventory item of SULFUR, a compact irregular brimstone-yellow mineral chunk with three broad angular crystalline lobes joined into one squat clump. Lemon-yellow faces, pale cream-yellow facet highlights, muted ochre shadow creases. Recognizably raw sulfur, NOT metallic gold, cheese, cloth, a bag, powder, or tall quartz spikes. Use the attached cloth only as a STYLE reference for purposeful pixel clusters and material detail; invent a mineral silhouette, no fabric features or blue stripe. High-resolution pixel-art master composed for a tiny inventory sprite: strong stepped silhouette, three large readable facets, then sparse short broad chips and fracture marks on each face. Material marks approximately 5–8 percent of object width, lower contrast than structural creases; keep surfaces varied but not noisy or blank plastic. About twelve to sixteen deliberate colors, two or three major tones per face, connected clusters, upper-left light. No fine grain, tiny crystals, dithering, smooth gradients, glows or sparkles. Three-quarter view. One centered object, generous transparent padding, genuine transparent background, no floor or cast shadow, no text or border.

criteria.family_consistency: Matches coarse clusters and upper-left light of approved cloth; uses fracture marks instead of fabric weave.
criteria.controls_readability: Native-size export keeps three faces and subordinate chips visible on light/dark backgrounds.
criteria.gameplay_scope: Existing sulfur item, no recipes or balance changes.

criteria.matches_direction: Native sprite retains three yellow lobes, shadow creases and broad mineral texture.
criteria.geometry_uvs: 32x32 RGBA,28px extent,binary alpha,16 colors; standard item/generated model.

criteria.assembly_interfaces: Existing sulfur item model target only; no assembly or ports.

criteria.states_motion: Static native item; held view reviewed.
